sheets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: matched raster icon atlas for the galaxy map of a sci-fi strategy game.
OUTPUT: Exactly 1536 pixels wide by 1024 pixels high, landscape 3:2. Opaque pure BLACK (#000000) canvas.
LAYOUT: Exactly SIX distinct glyphs, in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid with no visible grid. Each cell is exactly 512x512. Cell centers are (256,256), (768,256), (1280,256), (256,768), (768,768), (1280,768). Each complete glyph fits within about 332x332 centered in its cell (65% of cell width), with ample completely black space between glyphs. Do not merge cells or add decorative filler.
STYLE: Each glyph is a solid pure WHITE (#FFFFFF) silhouette with any interior details cut out in pure BLACK. A strict two-color binary image: white ink and black void ONLY, no gray or off-white pixels, no anti-aliased gray edges. Bold geometric hard-surface science-fiction shapes; clean straight cuts, chamfered corners, simple smooth curves. Thick filled shapes, not thin line illustrations. Aim for the same apparent weight across all six glyphs, with major stems, ring bands and solid bars about 48 pixels thick and negative-space channels at least 32 pixels wide. Very sparse interior detail. The symbols must remain recognizable at 16x16.
VIEW: Strictly flat 2D top-down or front-on; zero perspective, isometric view, volume, 3D, shading, gradients, glow, texture, noise or wear.
NO TEXT: No text, letters, numbers, labels, titles, logo words, watermark, frames, grid lines, enclosing icon circles or borders. Rings, shields, radar arcs and brackets are allowed only when explicitly part of the subject, never as a generic surrounding badge. Draw only the six requested subjects in the requested positions.

SHEET 1 of 4 — EXPLORATION SITES. Establish the style master for the whole four-sheet set.
Subjects in reading order:
TOP LEFT: A derelict ship, top-down, its angular hull visibly snapped into two large recognizable halves with a clear broad black gap between them. Exactly THREE small detached angular debris chips near the break. Keep the silhouette simple and ship-like.
TOP MIDDLE: A ring space station seen exactly front-on: one broad structural outer ring, FOUR broad straight spokes, a solid central hub, and ONE solar-panel bar projecting from the ring. The ring is the station itself, not a frame around it.
TOP RIGHT: An asteroid cluster of exactly THREE angular polygonal rocks: one large faceted rock and two smaller rocks. Suggest facets with only one or two broad black cuts, never shading.
BOTTOM LEFT: A spatial anomaly represented by a compact THREE-ARM spiral rift, three thick sweeping tapered white arms turning around one small black cut-out central core.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: A precursor artifact: a tall THREE-BLADED obelisk, with a central spear-like blade flanked by two shorter angular blades, and a sharp chevron-shaped base. Symmetrical, solid and monumental, not a letter.
BOTTOM RIGHT: An unidentified sensor contact: one small solid white dot and exactly THREE partial radar arcs around it. The arcs are thick, interrupted curves, not complete enclosing circles. No crosshair, no extra dots.
Make all six glyphs equally bold, balanced and carefully centered.

SHEET 2 of 4 — CONTRACTS, PART 1.
Input image 1 is ONLY the style, canvas and grid reference from sheet 1. Create a NEW sheet with SIX NEW symbols. Match its bold white filled silhouettes, chamfered geometric forms, heavy simple curves, black cut-outs, visual weight, margins and cell centers exactly. Preserve the 1536x1024 output and 3x2 layout. Do NOT reuse any exploration-site subjects.

Subjects in reading order:
TOP LEFT — BOUNTY: a targeting reticle formed by four short thick cardinal targeting marks or corners, with a jagged raider spaceship silhouette at its center, top-down. Keep the ship recognizable, broad and angular, not a star. Reticle and ship are separated by clear black.
TOP MIDDLE — PATROL: one solid angular shield with a single thick circular arrow sweeping around it. The arrow has a large clear triangular head and an open gap. No extra enclosing circle.
TOP RIGHT — SALVAGE: a bold cargo crate directly beneath a three-finger grappling claw. Exactly THREE visible heavy claw fingers, central and two outer jaws, open toward the crate. One broad black seam in the crate; no tiny detail.
BOTTOM LEFT — ESCORT: a boxy freighter viewed top-down inside a shield-shaped frame. The shield is a broad white silhouette with a large black interior cut-out, and the freighter is solid white inside that black area. Thick shield walls, generous clear gap around the freighter. No additional border.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — COMBAT OBJECTIVE: two crossed angular chevron blades, over a small thick target ring at their crossing. Strong diagonal X silhouette. Use black separations to keep the two blades and central target legible. No outer badge.
BOTTOM RIGHT — ENFORCEMENT: a filled star-shaped marshal's badge, with a broad horizontal bar across its center, visibly projecting to the left and right beyond the star. Simple bold geometry and small black separations defining the bar. No letters or other markings.

Strictly two colors: perfectly flat #FFFFFF glyphs and #000000 background/cut-outs. No texture or grain even inside the white shapes; no gray, thin outlines, shading or added text.

SHEET 3 of 4 — CONTRACTS, PART 2.

Match the two references as one family. Output exactly 1536x1024 pixels.

Subjects in reading order:
TOP LEFT — STRATEGIC CONTROL: one angular pennant flag planted on a planet's curved horizon. A short thick vertical pole and a solid triangular pennant above a broad shallow arc or dome of horizon. Only a horizon segment, not a complete enclosing planet circle. Compact, bold and centered.
TOP MIDDLE — REGIONAL MANDATE: exactly FOUR bold right-angle corner brackets framing a DOTTED SQUARE region. The inner square is suggested by large evenly spaced isolated square dots, with the center black and empty. No filled central panel. Large enough dots and gaps to survive reduction to 16 pixels.
TOP RIGHT — MEGAPROJECT: a simple rectilinear construction scaffold supporting a partly built ring segment. Exactly one incomplete thick ring with a clearly missing quarter, integrated into two heavy uprights and two sparse horizontal scaffold bars. A construction glyph, flat elevation, no perspective or tiny lattice.
BOTTOM LEFT — SURVEY: a radar dish in simple side profile, a solid concave bowl tilted upward on a short pedestal, with exactly TWO thick short sweep arcs radiating from its open side. No extra star, dot or outline.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — DELIVERY: one cargo crate with a bold forward arrow pointing right. A solid chamfered box with one broad black seam and a large attached or adjacent rightward white arrow. Box and arrow together must fit the cell as one balanced glyph, with clear black cut-out separation.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MAP PIN: a simple angular flag on a short thick pole. One bold right-facing pennant and one short pole, flat profile. No map-pin teardrop, no planet, no base circle and no extra marker. Give the flag enough solid area to match the other glyphs' visual weight.

Exactly six glyphs, no labels or extra marks. Two flat colors only: pure #FFFFFF and #000000. No texture or gray edge shading.

It must have NO visible top plane, NO visible side plane, NO diagonal perspective edges and NO 3D volume. One vertical black seam divides the flat rectangle into two white panels. Retain a large bold pure-white arrow pointing right beside the crate. Crate plus arrow centered together at (768,768), fitting approximately 332x332. Keep all other glyphs and their positions unchanged: flag on planet horizon, dotted region in brackets, ring under construction, radar dish with two arcs, simple flag.
Also enforce the specified flat TWO-COLOR raster appearance across the image: uniformly #FFFFFF white ink and #000000 black void; no gray, off-white, grain, texture, gradient or soft shadow. Clean hard binary edges with no antialiasing. No text or added symbols.
